<function name="GetNetworkedString" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
<deprecated>You should use <page>Entity:GetNWString</page> instead.</deprecated>

Retrieves a networked string value at specified index on the entity that is set by <page>Entity:SetNetworkedString</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="string">The key that is associated with the value</arg>
		<arg name="fallback" type="string" default="">The value to return if we failed to retrieve the value. ( If it isn't set )</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">The retrieved value</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
